Class NonGenericTypeDeserializerGenerator

java.lang.Object
me.bristermitten.mittenlib.annotations.compile.deserializer.NonGenericTypeDeserializerGenerator
public class NonGenericTypeDeserializerGenerator extends Object
Generates deserialization code for non-generic types (including primitive types, boxed primitives, strings, enums, config-annotated classes, custom-deserialized classes, and objectMapper fallbacks).

The generator processes types in the following order of priority:

  1. Direct Type Match (short-circuits if object already matches target type)
  2. DataTree Type Match (converts literal DataTree values to primitives/strings)
  3. Custom Deserializers (CustomDeserializerFor) without Fallback
  4. Enums
  5. Config Types
  6. Custom Deserializers (CustomDeserializerFor) with Fallback
  7. Invalid Property / Object Mapper Fallback, either throwing an error or trying the ObjectMapper if nothing else works

    • dataTreeConvert

      public com.palantir.javapoet.CodeBlock dataTreeConvert(com.palantir.javapoet.TypeName type, com.palantir.javapoet.TypeName dataTreeType, com.palantir.javapoet.CodeBlock value)
      Translates a DataTree literal value to its corresponding JVM primitive type.
      Parameters:
      type - the target type we want to convert to (e.g. int, float)
      dataTreeType - the actual type wrapper inside the DataTree
      value - the code block representing the expression to convert
      Returns:
      a code block performing the primitive conversion (e.g. ((Integer) value).intValue())

    • handleNonGenericType

      public boolean handleNonGenericType(com.palantir.javapoet.MethodSpec.Builder builder, Property property, TypeElement dtoType, TypeMirror elementType, io.toolisticon.aptk.tools.TypeMirrorWrapper wrappedElementType, String fromMapName, com.palantir.javapoet.TypeName safeType)
      Generate deserialization code for non-generic properties. Tries all the cases described in the documentation of NonGenericTypeDeserializerGenerator, in order.
      Parameters:
      builder - the method spec builder
      property - the property being processed
      dtoType - the enclosing DTO class element
      elementType - the property type mirror
      wrappedElementType - the wrapped property type mirror
      fromMapName - the name of the variable containing the raw data
      safeType - the expected target type
      Returns:
      true if deserialization was fully generated/handled, false otherwise
